64oz Games are crowdfunding their 3D printed dice stamped with Braille and Roman numerals, specially made for tabletop roleplaying games.

They have already met the goal and are working on stretch goals:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/64ouncegames/braille-rpg-dice-from-64-oz-games/description

While this looks really neat on paper, I'm not sure how smart this is.

3d printing in its current level of technology has issues with very small and detailed things, things like Braille. It's also prone to breakdowns in the machine, I see just about as many failed prints as I do perfect ones. And using 3d printing as a primary manufacturing process is a bit problematic, its better for one-off builds or custom-made replacement parts.

The initial prototypes make sense but they might be better off using traditional molds and casting for the mass production.
